sections.text:
This document out lines the major 
maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed every five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the title block

The pump function: transfer the fuel oil (Mazout 
& Solar) to fuel oil storage tanks and can be recirculated from one Mazout 
oil storage tank similary solar oil.

EDEPC التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة المهندس. Samir
Abd-Elgalil, accepted by eng. Mohamed Abdel Khaffar
Al-Arish Power Station general manager, approved by 
eng Yousry Mohamed Salama head sector and certified by eng Aly Mostafa Al Lethy 
EDEPC inspection & quality control head sector.

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة الأمان المناسبة للهوية.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل.

Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminal of the pump motor

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction
valves
Be sure pump must be completely drainage.

sections.text: Mark should be punch on pump

Empty the gear casing and take of gear casing (19) after having unscrewed lock 
 nut.
Pull of gear (54,55) remove keys and bushes.

Remove hex. Nut screw (83), washer (84) from the casing on run drive end side 
 bearing housing (6).

Take of the bearing housing ( NDE ) from the pump casing together with roller 
 casing.
Press the roller out of bearing casing (6).
Take out stationary carbon ring of mech. Seal and take out mech. Seal.
Take out the roller bearing from the casing.
Pull the coupling half from drive shaft (30).
Check mech. Seal surfaces for wear .
